item.title: Evolving 6G Beyond Speed: Interview with Qualcomm’s Dr Durga Malladi
item.description:
For FDM CCS Insight's Predictions for 2027 and Beyond event, I spoke with Dr Durga Malladi, Executive Vice President and General Manager of Technology Planning, Edge Solutions and Data Center ...

For FDM CCS Insight’s Predictions for 2027 and Beyond event, I spoke with Dr Durga Malladi, Executive Vice President and General Manager of Technology Planning, Edge Solutions and Data Center at Qualcomm, about the arrival of 6G and how it’ll evolve. The timing was good because of clear industry momentum to move quickly: at MWC Barcelona in March 2026, 58 companies from across the industry committed to commercial 6G by 2029.

item.title: Technology Outages: Have We Learnt the Lessons?
item.description:

The technology industry has become reasonably good at investigating major failures and explaining what went wrong. But the question is whether those lessons consistently translate into better resilience across the organizations that depend on its systems.

item.title: Commercial Upper 6 GHz Launches in the UAE Demonstrate Its Global Value
item.description:
With rising mobile data traffic, the upper 6 GHz spectrum band is proving to be a valuable asset to meet users' expectations in markets where it has been deployed, such ...

With rising mobile data traffic, the upper 6 GHz spectrum band is proving to be a valuable asset to meet users’ expectations in markets where it has been deployed, such as the United Arab Emirates (UAE). At a recent panel at the Telecom Review Leaders’ Summit, speakers from du and Etisalat UAE were joined by Ericsson, GSMA, Huawei, SPD and TDRA to mark the commercial launch of upper 6 GHz, highlighting the UAE’s progress in moving from spectrum planning to commercial deployment.

item.title: The Realistic Potential of Satellite Direct-to-Device Services
item.description:

Satellite direct-to-device services are positioned by some in the industry as a way to fill gaps in rural mobile coverage. But others, like SpaceX, believe it can do even more. I was recently invited by Virgin Media O2 to see where the technology is today and get a sense of where it’s going.

item.title: Valkey and the Hidden Foundations of the Digital Enterprise
item.description:
Customers rarely think about the infrastructure supporting their digital experiences. A mobile subscriber expects account information to appear promptly and a retailer needs transactions to complete without disruption. Few consider ...

Customers rarely think about the infrastructure supporting their digital experiences. A mobile subscriber expects account information to appear promptly and a retailer needs transactions to complete without disruption. Few consider the databases, caches and other software components working behind the scenes. Yet when those foundations struggle, the consequences become very visible indeed.

item.title: Can Google Move Beyond the Chromebook?
item.description:
Google has spent years building its laptop business on Chromebooks: relatively affordable devices designed largely around web-based apps and services. In May 2026, the company announced Googlebook, a new category ...

Google has spent years building its laptop business on Chromebooks: relatively affordable devices designed largely around web-based apps and services. In May 2026, the company announced Googlebook, a new category of laptops that brings together Android technology, features from ChromeOS and Google’s Gemini AI. The first models, made by Acer, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo, went on sale in selected markets in October.

item.title: India Mobile Congress 2026: From Smartphones to Wearables and Semiconductors
item.description:
From 7 to 10 October, India hosted the 10th edition of India Mobile Congress (IMC) in New Delhi. As in previous years, the event reflected a gradual shift away from ...

From 7 to 10 October, India hosted the 10th edition of India Mobile Congress (IMC) in New Delhi. As in previous years, the event reflected a gradual shift away from smartphones to a broader set of technology products. At the 2025 event, Samsung was the only major smartphone-maker to maintain a dedicated booth. This year, even Samsung was absent.

item.title: Google’s Gemini Agent Puts Workplace Delegation to the Test
item.description:

Google’s announcement of a new Gemini agent in Gemini Enterprise combines conversational assistance with autonomous task execution. Alongside it, Google is introducing AI coworkers, persistent agents with their own workplace identities, permissions and activity records.
